claim: For a physical not-all-equal reached stage whose ternary parts and individual wider holders form trees of single-name joins in each component, the uniform named pair rates recover all named components and their full allowed states within this class. limits: The all-size scope conditions the alternatives on this class. A wider holder on a cycle remains open in general. Parity has actual different births at equal rates, and also at equal states.
